Yes, I have. / No, I haven’t.

20-minute Have You Ever dice game. Open the linked title for the finished board and help card. Roll two dice: first = row, second = column. Say the prompt using the correct verb form. For questions, ask the person on your left. After “Yes, I have,” the group asks “When did you…?” Use the help card as needed; the third-die challenge is optional. Students may pass. Game PDF: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-3uBrAI6C5cjYuEl7_kEeoU7nmseaxIY/view?usp=drivesdk
